groups.name: Hellenic Ornithological Society (HOS)
groups.blurb: The national bird society and BirdLife partner, working since 1982 to conserve birds and habitats across Greece.

groups.name: BirdWING (BirdWatching In Northern Greece)
groups.blurb: Community group raising awareness of birds in northern Greece with over 600 international members.

groups.name: Antikythira Bird Observatory
groups.blurb: Research station operated by HOS monitoring migratory bird species in the Aegean Sea.

groups.name: Birding in Greece
groups.blurb: Public Facebook group for bird watching enthusiasts in Athens and central Greece.

groups.name: Lesvos Birdwatching
groups.blurb: Community group organising guided birdwatching and photography on Lesvos Island.

groups.name: BirdLife Cyprus
groups.blurb: The national bird society and BirdLife partner, formed in 2003 to protect Cyprus birds and habitats.

groups.name: BirdLife Cyprus Facebook Group
groups.blurb: Public Facebook community for birders and bird enthusiasts throughout Cyprus.

groups.name: Doğa Derneği (Nature Society)
groups.blurb: The national bird society and BirdLife partner, working on species protection and bird conservation across Turkey.

groups.name: eKuşbank (eBird Turkey)
groups.blurb: Citizen science platform and bird sighting database integrated with global eBird network since 2015.

groups.name: KuzeyDoga (Northeastern Nature)
groups.blurb: Conservation NGO based in Kars conducting bird research and community education in northeastern provinces.

groups.name: Bulgarian Society for the Protection of Birds (BSPB)
groups.blurb: The national bird society and BirdLife partner, Bulgaria's largest conservation NGO with local structures nationwide.

groups.name: Atlas of Breeding Birds in Bulgaria
groups.blurb: Citizen science project collecting breeding bird distribution data for Bulgaria's second bird atlas.

groups.name: Bulgarian Bird Ringing Scheme
groups.blurb: National bird ringing scheme operated by the Bulgarian Ornithological Centre tracking migration and population dynamics.

groups.name: Green Balkans
groups.blurb: Bulgaria's oldest conservation NGO founded 1988, leading rare species and habitat protection work nationwide.

groups.name: Birds of Prey Protection Society (BPPS)
groups.blurb: Specialist society established 1990 focused on studying and protecting birds of prey in Bulgaria.

groups.name: Romanian Ornithological Society (SOR)
groups.blurb: The national bird society and BirdLife partner since 1997, operating from Bucharest, Cluj Napoca and Tulcea.

groups.name: Milvus Group
groups.blurb: Bird and nature protection association specialising in raptor conservation and bird ringing research.

groups.name: eBird Romania
groups.blurb: Citizen science sighting platform documenting Romanian bird distribution and abundance.

groups.name: Bird Protection and Study Society of Serbia (BPSSS)
groups.blurb: The national bird society and BirdLife partner since 2010, working on targeted species conservation.

groups.name: Bird Protection and Study Society of Serbia
groups.blurb: The national bird society and BirdLife partner, running conservation, monitoring and public outreach programmes.

groups.name: eBird Serbia
groups.blurb: Citizen science sighting platform for recording bird observations across Serbia.

groups.name: BIOM (Association BIOM)
groups.blurb: The national bird society and BirdLife partner, leading conservation NGO organising annual ornithological camps.

groups.name: eBird Croatia
groups.blurb: Citizen science platform for recording bird sightings and distribution across Croatia.

groups.name: DOPPS (Društvo za Opazovanje in Proučevanje Ptic Slovenije)
groups.blurb: The national bird society and BirdLife partner founded 1979, largest conservation NGO in Slovenia with five regional sections.

groups.name: DOPPS Facebook
groups.blurb: Public Facebook group for bird watching community in Slovenia.

groups.name: eBird Slovenia
groups.blurb: Citizen science platform for recording Slovenian bird sightings and observations.

name: Bosnia and Herzegovina
gaps: Limited online presence for Naše ptice; organisation confirmed active with bird ringing programs and annual Ornitofestival

groups.name: Ornithological Society Naše ptice
groups.blurb: A nonprofit ornithological society running bird ringing, monitoring and habitat protection since 2003.

groups.name: eBird Bosnia and Herzegovina
groups.blurb: Citizen science platform for recording bird sightings throughout Bosnia and Herzegovina.

groups.name: Albanian Ornithological Society (AOS)
groups.blurb: The biggest conservation NGO in Albania, running conservation programs, birdwatching tours and youth clubs.

groups.name: AOS Facebook
groups.blurb: Public Facebook page for Albanian Ornithological Society news and community.

groups.name: Conservation Youth Club Gjirokastra
groups.blurb: Youth group working with AOS as ambassadors for Egyptian Vulture protection in Gjirokastra region.

name: North Macedonia
gaps: Limited findable clubs beyond national organisation; SOR operates with branches but specific regional clubs not publicly listed

groups.name: Macedonian Ecological Society (MES)
groups.blurb: Founded 1972, the oldest environmental organisation in North Macedonia focusing on biodiversity conservation.

groups.name: eBird North Macedonia
groups.blurb: Citizen science platform for recording bird observations in North Macedonia.

groups.name: Center for Protection and Research of Birds (CZIP)
groups.blurb: Established 2000, BirdLife partner running bird ringing programs and biodiversity monitoring across Montenegro.

groups.name: eBird Montenegro
groups.blurb: Citizen science platform for recording Montenegro bird sightings and observations.

name: Kosovo
gaps: No independently confirmed national ornithological society was found for Kosovo; a LinkedIn listing under this name could not be corroborated as a real organisation and was dropped rather than published unverified. eBird Kosovo is listed as the best available public option.

groups.name: eBird Kosovo
groups.blurb: Citizen science platform for recording Kosovo bird observations and sightings.
